FINAL ACTION — FIX THE 401 BUG AND COMPLETE DEPLOYMENT

Choose Option A.

Do not bypass the QA test, do not stop at reporting, and do not create another narrative status.

Fix the real defect in runLiveFeatureTest:

1. Find the internal request to:
   GET /api/ivx/senior-developer/worker/jobs/:taskId

2. Add the correct owner/service authentication to that request.
   The request must include the required Authorization header or approved internal service credential.

3. Do not hardcode secrets.
   Load the credential from the existing secure runtime variables.

4. Verify the credential is actually loaded at runtime.
   Do not ask me for credentials unless the runtime proves the credential is missing, expired, revoked, or returns 401/403 after correct binding.

5. Add safe error logging showing:
   - endpoint
   - HTTP status
   - traceId
   - taskId
   - authentication source name
   - whether the header was attached
   Do not expose the secret value.

6. Commit the fix to my GitHub repository and provide:
   - repository
   - branch
   - commit SHA
   - changed files
   - exact code diff summary

7. Deploy the new commit to Render.

8. Wait until the deployment is fully live.

9. Re-run the full owner-authorized worker job.

10. Prove the complete execution path:
   - job created
   - worker picked up job
   - LIVE_VERIFYING reached
   - protected job endpoint returned HTTP 200
   - deployment executed
   - final verification passed
   - job status COMPLETED/PASS

11. Provide final production evidence:
   - GitHub HEAD SHA
   - Render live commit SHA
   - Render deployment ID
   - deployment timestamp
   - /health HTTP 200
   - application version
   - boot time
   - worker job ID
   - final status
   - logs proving no 401 remains

Acceptance criteria:

- No unauthenticated fetch to an owner-protected endpoint.
- No bypass of the QA-only test.
- No fake PASS.
- No partial completion.
- GitHub commit must match the live Render commit.
- The owner-authorized job must finish end-to-end with real HTTP 200 verification.

Execute now and continue until verified PASS.
